units.source_text: 吃过饭，我点上支烟，抽起来。

en.t: After dinner, I lit a cigarette and began to smoke.

units.source_text: 我没有起身，夫人也不好离开。

en.t: Since I did not get up, the lady of the house could not very well leave either.

units.source_text: 她叫女佣撤掉了碗筷后，又是给铁壶灌满水，又是擦拭着火盆沿儿的，干这干那地陪着我。

en.t: After she had the maid clear away the dishes, she stayed with me by doing one thing after another, filling the iron kettle with water and wiping the edge of the brazier.

units.source_text: 我问夫人有没有事要办，她说没有，然后反问我为什么问这个。

en.t: I asked her whether she had anything to do, and she said no, then asked me in return why I asked.

units.source_text: 我说：‘有点事想跟您谈一谈。’

en.t: I said, 'There is something I would like to talk with you about.'

units.source_text: ‘什么事啊？’夫人望着我的脸问道。

en.t: 'What is it?' she asked, looking into my face.

units.source_text: 她说话的口气轻飘飘的，跟我此时的心情很不协调。

en.t: Her tone was so light and airy that it did not fit my feelings at that moment at all.

units.source_text: 所以，我把要说的话又咽了下去。

en.t: So I swallowed back the words I had meant to say.

units.source_text: 我只好绕起了圈子，最后才含糊其词地问夫人，近来K没跟您说过什么吗？

en.t: I had no choice but to circle around the matter, and at last I vaguely asked her whether K had said anything to her lately.

units.source_text: 夫人显得很意外，反问我：‘说什么？’

en.t: She looked very surprised and asked me back, 'Said what?'

units.source_text: 还没等我回答，她反而问起我来：‘他跟你说过什么吗？’

en.t: Before I could answer, she instead asked me, 'Has he said anything to you?'
